title: How often do OECD member states update their tax treaties?
descriptions: By makig use of this database, the authors have studied the time between conclusion of tax treaties and their amendment, termination, or conclusion of a subsequent, succeeding, tax treaty. The results of this research will be published in an article published by the IBFD.
